FAQ

Common Questions

Will the website work on mobile?

Yes. The layout is designed mobile-first with responsive grids, readable typography and touch-friendly buttons.

Will WhatsApp and phone buttons work?

Yes. The website uses your number +91 7607627117 for direct WhatsApp and click-to-call actions.

Can I use this for WordPress?

The design can be recreated in WordPress/Elementor, or the supplied HTML can be hosted directly on compatible hosting.

Can customers submit reviews?

Yes. The package includes a PHP review endpoint with pending/approved status. On static-only hosting, connect a form backend instead.
